verdict.rationale: Windmill documents itself as a developer platform. It offers full-code scripting in many languages or any Docker image, workflows as code, and an official `wmill` CLI with Git-based deployment, so developers can write private integration code against external systems. However, the evidence never documents a dedicated connector or integration framework (for example, custom resource types) or a client SDK, so the connector-building part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of building reusable custom connectors or resource types, a documented SDK for integration authoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building a private integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI
